summary: Iteration 4 testing: Notifications + Depots/Geofencing + Weekly Digest. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (CRUD depots, off-site/on-site geofence detection, admin-only notifications, mark read/read-all, scan-alerts idempotent, checklist below-target auto-notification, weekly-digest mocked + persisted + downloadable, admin-only access enforced). APScheduler verified started for Mon 09:00 UTC via backend logs. Frontend smoke-tested on mobile viewport (390x844): login, bell icon w/ unread badge, NotificationsModal with read-all, Admin Panel→Depots tab, Add Depot modal (created + listed), Send Weekly Digest Now button. All flows work end-to-end.
